reply:
CMD is the default that gets replaced when you supply a command to `docker run`. ENTRYPOINT is what stays put unless you use `--entrypoint`. 

So no—you don't need a new image. `docker run image sh` will override the CMD and drop you into a shell. The `node server.js` never runs.

grade.note: Reply reverses prior claim and correctly agrees CMD is overridden while ENTRYPOINT needs --entrypoint.
